parameters.newDescription:
1) Obtain a Bronze, Silver and Golden Cogwheel to enter
the tower south of the entertainment district.
2) Investigate the Hall of Opportunity in the Entertainment
District for information on a Silver Cogwheel.
3) Find Wesker's house, between the Residential District
 and the Shopping District.
4) Enter the Clock Tower between the Shopping
 and Entertainment districts
5) Find and confront Wyndham
